info.title: Niu Console & Saved Session API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/docs/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/docs/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session,
platform authority, explicit delegated workspace capability or Provider membership stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` path segments refer to workspaces; legacy `provider` paths refer to Providers.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units; Provider purchase rates and customer charges are separate.

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

tags.description: Purpose-bound one-time invitations to join an organization or workspace. Acceptance requires an existing signed-in account with the intended email; no reusable member credential is issued.

get.summary: Inspect an authorization request after login
get.description: Requires a current user session. Returns bounded request metadata: client name, state, requested management capabilities and self-reported task context. It never returns the device secret or issued credential. Unknown and expired requests return 404; invalid session returns 401. Client label and task are self-reported, not authenticated authority. No-store.

task.description: Self-reported task context supplied by the client. Explain the request but never treat it as an authorization grant.

capabilities.description: Additional workspace management rights, requiring explicit browser approval. Empty by default; no platform administration.

404.description: Request unavailable or expired

post.summary: Approve or decline an agent connection
post.description: Requires an exact trusted same-origin Origin and a current Operator with write permission. Approval requires organization_id, workspace_id, allowed_models, ttl_seconds and an explicit invocation_allowed value, and checks write access to that workspace. Approved invocation also records the exact model interfaces; omitted interface scope never defaults to a paid grant. A decline may omit both scope fields; if supplied, both are checked. Installation credentials and inference keys cannot decide. Approval validates model aliases and stores explicit scope, fixed model names, financial boundary and finite credential lifetime; it does not return a credential. State transition is one-time, with expiry and active approver checks. Existing workspace billing constraints still apply. No-store.

invocation_allowed.description: Required on approval. Whether the issued credential may dispatch inference at all. False preserves separately granted discovery and management access. There is no omitted default; an absent value is rejected.

invocation_protocols.description: Exact model interfaces approved for invocation. Required when invocation_allowed is true; when invocation is disabled, omission is treated as all interfaces for compatibility and has no paid effect.

capabilities.description: Optional narrowed management capabilities approved by the human reviewer. When omitted, requested capabilities are preserved.

get.summary: List the current actor video intent index
get.description: Actor-owned workspace records: installation authority shares one installation actor, while operator actors are isolated even within the same workspace. Current workspace permission applies. Request content is retained for 30 days from creation or until deletion; expiry is unreadable immediately and background maintenance clears retained content. Identity tombstones remain. Deletion does not cancel an already accepted concurrent submission, erase its job or refund charges. Newest-first creation order with UUID tie-breaker. The index contains only intent identity, revision, expiry and retention state; it intentionally exposes no request, model or key content. Index access remains available for deleting retained content after key revocation. Read each intent separately under current key authorization. A cursor must belong to this actor and workspace.

put.summary: Save an immutable video submission intent with typed Niu references
put.description: Actor-owned workspace records: installation authority shares one installation actor, while operator actors are isolated even within the same workspace. Current workspace permission applies. Request content is retained for 30 days from creation or until deletion; expiry is unreadable immediately and background maintenance clears retained content. Identity tombstones remain. Deletion does not cancel an already accepted concurrent submission, erase its job or refund charges. Requires workspace write permission and an active selected key with model access and allowed source. A fresh client-generated intent UUID binds the exact request, original key and funding mode. Identical retries return the same record; changed input or key under that UUID conflicts. No attempt, upstream call or reservation is created. The internal idempotency identity is server-generated and is never exposed; use the submit operation rather than legacy job creation. Saving reference drafts reads only scoped material metadata and schema constraints. It never resolves private Provider URIs, reads upload bytes, queries upstream, reserves funds, inspects media or grants Active readiness. Original Niu references and explicit consent remain in the canonical request digest; all runtime bindings are revalidated at submit.

get.summary: Restore a saved video intent and its historical job
get.description: Accepts an internal UUID alias or permanent input reference. Both preserve existing workspace and actor authorization; mutation endpoints still require internal UUIDs. Current workspace Read permission and the original actor-owned intent are required. Restores saved request and job evidence independently of current inference key lifetime, model grants, source policy or Provider configuration. Original and available rotation-lineage key IDs are context only, never authority to submit, estimate or query upstream. Revoked/expired keys and lost model grants do not hide retained private input; deletion and original/bound-turn expiry still hide content immediately. Unknown submission evidence never grants permission to dispatch again. No upstream request, inference, reservation, settlement or write occurs. Storage failures remain errors.

post.summary: Explicitly submit or replay an immutable saved video intent
post.description: Actor-owned workspace records: installation authority shares one installation actor, while operator actors are isolated even within the same workspace. Current workspace permission applies. Request content is retained for 30 days from creation or until deletion; expiry is unreadable immediately and background maintenance clears retained content. Identity tombstones remain. Deletion does not cancel an already accepted concurrent submission, erase its job or refund charges. Requires write permission, matching retained revision and current key/model/source authorization. Uses only the saved request and original rotation lineage. Rechecks configured video admission and rejects a changed owner-funded/customer funding mode before a new dispatch. Concurrent and restarted calls use one original submission identity. Interrupted original preparation is read back, never assumed safe to dispatch again. HTTP 202 can represent unresolved submission and is not a completed generation or settled charge. Fresh submissions use the same 24-hour inspected-request and Niu creation-response Logs capture as direct creation, with x-niu-log-payloads: false opt-out. Capture uses the saved inspected video request, not this revision-only submit body. Replay does not create or restore capture.

get.summary: Read a mutable personal Video composer
get.description: One mutable actor-private Video composer per workspace. Operators are isolated; installation credentials share the installation actor. Read requires workspace Read permission. Absent state returns null payload and revision zero. Retention is 30 days after the last confirmed edit; expired content is hidden immediately and background maintenance erases it. Reads expose the expiry tombstone revision before maintenance. Saved key/model/reference identities are context only, including unavailable historical resources; they confer no current access or readiness. No inference, Provider calls, reservation, media reads or inspection occur.

401.description: Missing or invalid administration/member authentication.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permission or scope.

put.summary: Save or clear a mutable personal Video composer
put.description: One mutable actor-private Video composer per workspace. Operators are isolated; installation credentials share the installation actor. Read requires workspace Read permission. Absent state returns null payload and revision zero. Retention is 30 days after the last confirmed edit; expired content is hidden immediately and background maintenance erases it. Reads expose the expiry tombstone revision before maintenance. Saved key/model/reference identities are context only, including unavailable historical resources; they confer no current access or readiness. No inference, Provider calls, reservation, media reads or inspection occur. Write requires workspace Write permission and allowed browser Origin. Typed bounded partial composition may omit model/key/session and required model controls. Only the nine existing non-URL VideoSchema scalar control names are accepted; integer edits may remain strings. References use exact provider_asset/workspace_asset shapes, canonical nonnil Niu IDs and explicit workspace processing consent. No raw URL, inline media, short-lived ingestion, credential or billing fields are accepted. Key/reference metadata must belong to the workspace; session context must belong to the actor. Saving does not require an active historical key or grant action access. Full current schema, key/model eligibility, reference binding, consent and inspection remain explicit estimate/submission requirements. Null or omitted payload clears content while retaining the CAS revision. Stale revisions, including revisions predating expiry or clear, return 409. Workspace deletion refuses retained drafts; cleared/expired tombstones alone do not prevent empty-workspace deletion.

get.summary: Read the persistent personal Chat draft
get.description: The draft is isolated by authenticated personal owner and workspace. Operators have distinct drafts; installation credentials share the installation owner. Read authorization and workspace scope are required. An absent draft returns null payload and revision zero.

put.summary: Save or clear the personal Chat draft with an expected revision
put.description: Write authorization and workspace scope are required. Browser-member requests require an allowed Origin when password authentication is configured; other requests also undergo Origin validation. Strict typed JSON rejects unknown fields. A referenced conversation must belong to the same owner and workspace. Saving does not call a model. The 24 MiB route body bound applies. Compare-and-swap prevents stale tabs from overwriting a newer draft; clearing retains and advances the revision.

403.description: Insufficient permission or workspace scope. Missing or disallowed browser Origin also refuses the write.

get.description: Actor-private within one workspace: installation credentials share the installation actor; each operator has an isolated owner. Current workspace Read is required for reads and Write for mutations; API-key inference credentials alone do not authorize these administrator routes. Saved-state reads and all writes never dispatch, refresh or replay inference. Read categories are video (default) and chat; legacy Chat write APIs remain unchanged. Revisions and sequences are decimal strings. Video instructions follow existing Chat/intents JSON storage (not application-encrypted at rest); Video content expires after 30 days and is hidden immediately, then cleared by retention maintenance. Task identity and history remain. Archive does not cancel tasks or remove outputs/billing. Stable descending creation time then UUID pagination; before refers to an actor-visible record independently of its current archive state; archiving a prior page cursor does not invalidate traversal. Invalid cursor returns 400, never an empty page. Limit 1..100; next_before is null when exhausted. Set category=chat for a read-only bridge over the existing actor-private Chat record. The same route defaults to video; IDs are scoped independently by category. Chat metadata uses database clocks and current guarded-write revision. Missing Chat title is null, never replaced by an internal ID. Chat turns preserve comparison branches, not one running conversation task. Per-turn creation/expiry clocks are unknown and null; missing retained prompt yields missing state and null instruction. Turn references are read-only scoped identity/sequence/instruction digests and cannot be used with Video writes. Branch phase/output are exact saved conversation content; actual execution references require a current workspace attempt and matching model. Customer charges are hydrated from the existing ledger projection; no saved procurement fields are returned. Chat retention and writes stay under the legacy Chat contract; Video 30-day instruction retention does not apply to this bridge.

put.summary: Bind a saved Video intent to a private turn
put.description: Current workspace Write and actor-owned video session/turn/intent required. This only binds saved restoration identity and never dispatches, refreshes or automatically submits inference. One turn and one intent form an immutable association within the same owner/workspace. A fresh association requires expected session revision, an unarchived session and retained turn/intent content. Identical binding retries are side-effect-free even after revision advances, archive, deletion or expiry; changed binding conflicts. If the turn already references a task, it must equal the actual attempt from the original intent submission identity. Session reads resolve any saved original attempt directly from that identity after a lost submission/association response without another inference call. Pending/not-dispatched/unknown outcomes are never assumed free or safe to resend. Safe intent projection includes id, revision, model, content state and submission state, not raw request, key secret or private upstream references. Turn content deletion/expiry clears the bound retained intent copy under turn-to-intent locking while preserving submission tombstones, task evidence, billing and diagnostics. Intent and turn keep their original 30-day retention deadlines; neither is extended. Legacy Video intent APIs remain compatible and explicit submission continues through their submit endpoint. The bound intent is canonical for the actual restored Video draft/request, including model, controls and material inputs. The separately saved turn instruction may be a review note and is not represented as proof of the dispatched prompt; reads never substitute it for missing retained intent content.

get.description: Current authenticated member only; the target member is derived from authentication, never supplied by the caller. Requires an operator/member session with Read permission; installation bearer credentials are rejected. Browser member-cookie sessions are also supported by the existing authentication middleware. All responses carry Cache-Control: no-store. Returns the saved color mode; when no member preference exists, returns the installation branding default appearance. No revision field is exposed.

All responses carry Cache-Control: no-store. When password authentication is configured, cookie/browser writes require a valid Origin and cookie-request checks; bearer writes validate Origin when supplied. Saves one of system, light or dark. This endpoint has no revision precondition; subsequent accepted writes replace the saved mode. Route body limit is 1024 bytes; rejected bodies are mapped to JSON invalid-request errors.

name.description: Trimmed before saving; must contain 1 to 100 Unicode characters and no control characters.

avatar_data_url.description: Optional PNG data URL. Null or omission removes the existing avatar. Decoded and normalized PNG must each be at most 131072 bytes and dimensions at most 256 by 256 pixels.

expected_revision.description: Numeric revision returned by GET; a profile with no saved customization starts at zero. Successful update increments it.

put.summary: Change the signed-in member's password with current-password proof
put.description: All member roles may change their own password; installation credentials cannot. No target member or email is accepted. Verification uses shared sign-in throttling and bounded workers. Credential revision checks prevent concurrent resets from being overwritten. Success revokes all of this member's sessions atomically with audit records and requires fresh sign-in. Browser-cookie requests require the configured Origin and clear the cookie on success. Failed changes preserve sessions and do not clear the cookie. JSON bodies are limited to 4096 bytes. All responses are non-cacheable.

400.description: Invalid input or password policy failure; UTF-8 byte limit is 1024

401.description: Invalid session or incorrect current password

403.description: Installation identity or invalid browser origin

409.description: Credential revision changed during verification; no reset applied

503.description: Password change unavailable; do not assume completion

post.summary: Revoke and clear the current browser member session
post.description: Requires the configured HTTPS Origin; supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be a single same-origin value. Revokes the supplied member session and clears the cookie. Already expired or revoked sessions also clear the cookie successfully. Storage failure does not claim successful revocation or clear the cookie. Responses use Cache-Control no-store.

204.description: Session unusable and cookie expired; no response body

401.description: Missing or malformed member cookie

403.description: Missing or mismatched Origin

503.description: Revocation unavailable; retry before assuming sign-out

post.summary: Sign out the member session supplied in Authorization
post.description: Available to every member role, independently of password login configuration. Revokes only the supplied active session and records a metadata-only audit event atomically. Other sessions remain active. Installation credentials are not member sessions. When password login is configured, a supplied Origin must match its HTTPS origin. All responses use Cache-Control no-store.

204.description: Current session revoked; no response body

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or already revoked member session

403.description: Supplied Origin does not match the configured origin

503.description: Storage unavailable; retry sign-out before assuming revocation

get.summary: Read the current administrator's scope and permissions
get.description: Revalidates the bearer credential on every request. Returns installation authority or the operator's current organization/workspace scope and role. Permissions are UI hints; every management operation independently enforces authorization. Responses contain no credentials and use Cache-Control no-store.

200.description: Current identity and effective role permissions.

operating_mode.description: Deployment-wide NIU_OPERATING_MODE policy. Missing configuration defaults to internal; only explicit resale enables commercial operation. Read-only in the dashboard; independent of live/test payments and not an end-user BYOK grant.

available.description: Only identities currently granted to this session. Provider is not a supported login role.

switchable.description: Whether this browser sign-in may select another role.

available.description: Whether this browser sign-in has a current platform administrator grant.

enabled.description: Whether platform authority is activated for this browser session.

provider_memberships.description: Retired compatibility field; always empty. Provider membership is not a login role or an access grant.

platform_admin.description: Explicit platform administration capability; does not expand customer workspace scope.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked administrator credential.

put.summary: Select an assigned role for the current browser sign-in
put.description: Accepts user or admin only. Available roles, the active role and whether switching is supported come from GET /api/v1/session data.roles. New password sign-ins start as user. Selecting admin requires a current explicit platform grant and activates administration for at most six hours, bounded by session expiry. Selection is persisted and audited on the server; it does not change tenant Owner/Admin/Viewer permissions, grant membership, issue credentials or expand workspace scope. Provider self-service is not currently supported. Explicit automation and installation credentials cannot switch role. Read back session identity after an uncertain response. Cookie requests require the trusted same origin.

401.description: Invalid

403.description: The requested role is not currently granted or same-origin checks failed.

put.summary: Switch the active organization for the current member session
put.description: Requires an authenticated member session. Accepts an organization UUID, durable slug, or retained slug alias already granted to this account identity. Updates the active operator membership bound to the session and returns the refreshed session identity.

200.description: Updated session identity scoped to the selected organization.

400.description: Invalid organization reference or JSON body.

401.description: Invalid, expired or revoked member session.

403.description: Installation credentials cannot switch member organization scope.

404.description: No active membership in the requested organization.

post.summary: Link an issued operator access token to the current member account
post.description: Requires an authenticated member session and a valid, unrevoked operator session token. Links the target operator membership to the caller's account identity with explicit token proof, switches the current session to that membership, and returns the updated session identity. Rejects tokens already linked to a different account identity with 409.

200.description: Membership linked and active session switched.

401.description: Invalid, expired or revoked member session.

403.description: Installation credentials cannot claim member memberships.

409.description: The operator membership is already linked to a different account identity.

post.description: Authenticated member session required; installation credentials are rejected. Atomically revalidates invitation state, expiry, version, email binding, inviter authority and target scope, then creates the exact invited member role/scope for the caller's account identity and switches the current session to it. No reusable operator access token is issued. The redemption secret is consumed exactly once. Replay by the same account identity returns the completed membership with replayed true; another identity is denied. Existing operator sessions and roles are not broadened. Returns the refreshed session plus accepted invitation metadata. Responses are not cached.

200.description: Invitation accepted or reconciled; the refreshed session is scoped to the invited role and workspace.

403.description: Signed-in account email does not match the invitation, or the inviter no longer has authority.

404.description: Invitation is invalid, expired, canceled or already used by another identity.

409.description: The account already belongs to the organization; change the existing member instead.

413.description: Body exceeds the bounded request size.

get.description: Current organization Owner or installation administrator only. Returns at most 100 recent invitations visible in the caller's scope: project-scoped Owners see only their workspace's invitations, while organization-wide authority sees organization-wide and workspace invitations. Redemption secrets and token digests are never returned. Status is derived from acceptance, cancellation and current expiry.

403.description: Member management requires organization Owner authority.

404.description: Organization is outside the caller's scope.

post.description: Current organization Owner or installation administrator only. Creates a short-lived, purpose-bound invitation for one email, role and workspace/organization scope. The response returns the redemption token exactly once and stores only its SHA-256 digest. A new invitation for the same organization, workspace and email replaces any earlier pending invitation, invalidating its link. This installation has no configured email provider: delivery is `not_configured`, no email is sent, and the owner receives a copyable one-time link. The invitation cannot grant broader rights than the caller may assign, and an email that already has active access in the organization is rejected. No reusable access token or session is created. Responses are not cached.

201.description: Invitation created; the redemption token is returned once.

400.description: Invalid email, role, scope or expiry.

403.description: Member management requires organization Owner authority.

404.description: Organization or workspace is outside the caller's scope.

409.description: The email already belongs to an active member of this organization.

413.description: Body exceeds the bounded request size.

post.description: Authenticated member session required; installation credentials are rejected. Resolves one invitation secret supplied in the request body so it does not appear in a request path. Returns the inviting organization, workspace, role, intended email, expiry, lifecycle status and whether the current account email matches. The invitation token is never returned. Acceptance still requires an exact email match and a pending unexpired invitation.

200.description: Invitation metadata, including its current lifecycle status and the caller's binding state. A canceled invitation can be previewed.

403.description: Member session required.

404.description: No invitation matches the supplied token.

413.description: Body exceeds the bounded request size.

delete.description: Current organization Owner or installation administrator with authority over the invitation's exact scope. Cancellation prevents further redemption and records an immutable lifecycle event. Repeated cancellation is idempotent. Accepted invitations cannot be canceled here because the resulting member must be managed in the member list. Foreign and organization-wide invitations outside a project-scoped caller's authority are concealed with 404.

204.description: Invitation is canceled or was already canceled.

403.description: Member management requires organization Owner authority.

404.description: Invitation is outside the caller's scope.

409.description: Invitation was already accepted; manage the member instead.

expires_at_ms.description: Immutable original intent deadline. A bound turn may expire or delete content earlier; content_state determines availability.

key_id.description: Available active rotation-lineage key with the model grant, otherwise the original saved key. Context only; current action authorization remains required and no secret is returned.

submission_state.description: Dispatch and job status are read from one bounded read-only database snapshot. not_dispatched means original preparation has no recorded dispatch; it never grants a fresh submission right.

session_binding.description: Original actor-private session and turn binding, if any. Internal routing references only; never render these IDs. Remains available after content deletion or expiry and does not authorize inference. Explicit null means no saved binding; older gateways with no field must not be interpreted as confirmed absence.

VideoIntentRequest.description: Validated original Niu request with configured defaults materialized at save time, at most 60 KiB JSON. Supports text, Provider-owned image/audio/video IDs, or workspace-owned image IDs with explicit consent. Provider/local reference families cannot be mixed. Only scoped metadata is read at save; no bytes, upload, Provider query, processing readiness or dispatch. No private Provider URI or schema placeholder is persisted. URL, inline data, ingested_image and callbacks are unsupported. Current model schema, policy and funding mode apply; actual live binding, Active readiness and inspection are rechecked only at explicit submit.

role.description: Explicit configured role; null, whitespace padding and control characters are invalid.

revision.description: Zero before the first saved draft; integer revision, not a string.

keyId.description: Selected API key in this workspace. Retained after revocation for explicit recovery; never grants invocation authority. Omitted on legacy drafts.

oneOf.description: Optional saved conversation belonging to this owner and workspace.

items.description: Nonblank and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes; saving a draft does not invoke or grant access to this model.

content.description: At most 6291456 UTF-8 bytes; stored text, not a server-fetched URL.

expected_revision.description: Exact last observed integer revision. Negative or stale values return 409; use zero for initial creation.

The turn instruction is the separately saved user instruction/review note, not asserted to be the historical submitted prompt.

owner.description: Internal authenticated actor reference; never a product display label.

id.description: Read-only derived reference from scoped session identity, sequence and retained instruction digest. Changing legacy instruction/order changes the reference; comparison output updates do not.

phase.description: Saved client comparison phase, never authoritative task state or upstream cancellation.

delivery.description: No email provider is configured; the one-time link is the supported delivery.

invited_by.description: Inviting member name; null for installation administration.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credential accepted by this operation. Inference uses a workspace API key; management requires an authorized member session or installation credential. See the operation description for required authority and scope.
